title: Python Basics - Variables and Data Types
description:
# Python Basics Assignment

Learn fundamental Python concepts including variables, data types, and basic operations.

questions.title: String Variables
questions.description:
Create a variable called `name` and assign your name to it. Then create a variable called `greeting` that combines "Hello, " with your name.

**Example Output:**
```

```

print(greeting)
